versions.notes: simulator section tidied up: status with statistics (connected for, response time, camera / thermal pictures per second, messages, sensor events, errors), «Simulators in the network» with «Search now» (asks every address of the own network, progress and result), per simulator: seen since, last message, number of messages, response time; settings and tools folded away.

simulators are found by themselves: every simulator announces itself every 2 s (UDP 8764), Motion Watch lists them («Use») and - with «find by itself» on and no working connection - takes over the address (a PC before the Pi); simulator requests never go through a proxy.

page /preview: the web page as on a phone or a tablet, upright or across, with or without full screen (button in the simulators and in the simulator section); the page may be shown in a frame of its own origin only (SAMEORIGIN).
the quick switches below the joystick can be chosen and arranged («Arrange» tile: tick, ▲ ▼, reset) - web page and window; the viewer count moved to the right in the header.
header shows how many watch right now: every browser with the page or a guest link open, plus the window on the Pi screen (when it is not minimised); the tooltip splits web / Pi screen.

simulator control on the web page for every simulator (CONTROL protocol 1: the simulator describes its scenarios, sliders, choices, switches and buttons itself - ready for a later 3D simulator on a PC); three example 360° video scenes (forest at night, car park at night with a thief, misty camping morning) made by the simulator itself; a running simulator now also restarts when Motion Watch has already put the new files in place.

the camera can also follow animals and other movement when no person is in the picture (also animals the AI does not know): it must go in one direction for 2 s, swinging branches are let go, off in strong wind; once chosen the animal is followed by its look while the camera turns. Video scenarios of the simulator chosen, played, deleted and uploaded from the web page. Simulator: the camera tilt was upside down (fixed).

simulator video scenarios: a 360° video (or a normal video) instead of the drawn world - real pictures, the cameras look around in it with the servos, big videos are made smaller once, rough thermal picture (what moves is warm), optional sensor events per video second (.json next to the video).
simulation with CPU saving: the AI runs only half as often (smoother CPU load when somebody is in the picture).

Simulator 3 - updates itself (on the Pi when Motion Watch starts, on a PC when it connects: it fetches the new version from Motion Watch, checks the checksums and restarts); much more real: a distance for every pixel, light that falls off with the distance, haze and fog, ground pattern, clouds, sun, stars, better figures, lens distortion, glare; thermal picture with physics (cold clear sky, ground warmed by the sun and cooling at night, warm walls, clothes, engine).
